sections.section_name: Section A - Objective Type / MCQs / True-False

questions.question_text: Which irrigation layout methodology is highly utilized in precision farming to conserve water by delivering moisture directly to plant roots?
What is the primary purpose of adding a drainage layer at the base of a rooftop gardening bed?
options: A) To retain all excess water
B) To allow excess water to flow out safely
C) To increase the weight of the soil
D) To encourage the growth of weeds
questions.answer: B) To allow excess water to flow out safely

questions.question_text: True or False: Precision farming relies heavily on GPS mapping and IoT sensors to accurately monitor and manage crop health.
Which of the following hand tools is primarily used in carpentry for smoothing and shaping wooden surfaces?
In the construction industry, the hardened mixture of cement, sand, gravel, and water is known as:
Which agronomic practice involves growing different types of crops in succession on the same land to preserve soil nutrients?
True or False: Coco peat is frequently used as a growing medium in rooftop gardening because it is significantly heavier than normal garden soil.
What is the specific role of a soil moisture sensor in a modern agricultural setup?
options: B) To detect wind speed and direction
C) To measure the volumetric water content in the soil
questions.answer: C) To measure the volumetric water content in the soil

questions.question_text: When shaping materials by cutting metal using a hacksaw or power saw, what is the mandatory safety gear for the operator?
options: B) Safety goggles and heavy gloves
questions.answer: B) Safety goggles and heavy gloves

questions.question_text: True or False: A plumb bob is a traditional construction tool used exclusively to establish a perfect vertical alignment for walls and pillars.
Explain why structural waterproofing layers are absolutely essential before initializing a rooftop gardening layout. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Waterproofing layers prevent moisture and continuous water drainage from seeping into the building's concrete slab, protecting the underlying structural foundation from fractures and decay.

questions.question_text: Define 'precision farming' and state its main objective in modern agriculture. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Precision farming uses technology like GPS and sensors to optimize crop yields. Its main objective is to maximize agricultural output while minimizing resource wastage.

questions.question_text: Why is 'curing' an important post-pouring step in concrete construction? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Curing maintains adequate moisture and temperature in freshly poured concrete, allowing it to achieve maximum structural strength and preventing surface cracks.

questions.question_text: Mention the primary industrial use of a lathe machine when shaping raw materials. [20-30 words]
questions.answer: A lathe machine rotates a workpiece on its axis to perform various operations like cutting, sanding, and drilling, creating perfectly symmetrical and cylindrical objects.

questions.question_text: What is hydroponics in the context of advanced agricultural practices? [20-30 words]
questions.answer: Hydroponics is a method of growing plants without soil, using mineral nutrient solutions dissolved in water, highly suitable for space-saving rooftop gardens.

questions.question_text: Detail the industrial layout criteria and safety steps required when operators are engaged in shaping heavy materials using electric machines. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: Operators must configure machine guards properly, calibrate speed metrics before starting, and wear protective equipment like safety goggles and heavy gloves. The workstation must keep a clear safety perimeter line to avoid workspace clutter and hazards.

questions.question_text: Describe the basic structural layers required to correctly set up a containerized planting bed for rooftop gardening. [30-40 words]
questions.answer: A standard rooftop container requires a bottom drainage layer of gravel, covered by a geotextile filter fabric. Above this, a lightweight growing medium comprising coco peat, compost, and perlite is added to support plant roots securely.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A farmer is shifting from traditional agriculture to a precision farming setup to combat water scarcity and low crop yields. Outline a comprehensive technological strategy to optimize resource usage and improve crop health monitoring. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The farmer should install a drip irrigation network integrated with IoT-based soil moisture sensors to deliver exact water quantities directly to root zones. Additionally, utilizing drone imagery and GPS mapping will help monitor crop health, detect pest infestations early, and apply fertilizers precisely, significantly reducing resource wastage and boosting yields.

questions.question_text: Read the following case context: A contractor is tasked with building a modern residential complex using eco-friendly materials and advanced shaping techniques. Explain the key sustainable construction practices and material shaping workflows they should implement on-site. [50-60 words]
questions.answer: The contractor must prioritize sourcing sustainable materials like fly-ash bricks and recycled steel. During the shaping phase, electric CNC machines should be used for precise cutting, minimizing raw material wastage. On-site workflows must include rainwater harvesting pits and solar panel integration, ensuring the final structure is environmentally sound and robust.
